title: CloserOutput (064 extension)
description: Augments the existing closer JSON contract with PR-checks gate signaling. Only the new/changed fields are shown here; existing fields (commit_sha, summary, etc.) remain as-is.

approved.description: True only when all required PR checks pass. False during pending or failure.

status.description: Disambiguates why approved=false. 'pending_checks' tells coordinare to HOLD (FR-005). 'checks_failed' bounces to implementer with failed_jobs.

failed_jobs.description: Names of refusing required checks. Required when status='checks_failed'. Surfaced verbatim to the implementer on bounce.

pending_jobs.description: Names of required checks still running. Informational when status='pending_checks'.

head_sha.description: PR HEAD SHA the closer evaluated. Coordinare compares against live HEAD to detect drift before honoring the decision.

checks_url.description: Convenience link to GitHub's checks tab for this PR.
